name: ifrota-web
description: Reescrita web do IFrota (originalmente PySide6 desktop) com o objetivo final de empacotar como APK Android via TWA (Trusted Web Activity).

scripts.sync: node build-www.mjs && cap sync android && node tools/preparar-android.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/routing.test.mjs && node tests/dados.test.mjs && node tests/texto-eventos.test.mjs
